feedback: Your essay presents a thoughtful and balanced discussion about cellphones in South African classrooms. You make strong points regarding equity, teacher control, and the importance of offering printed alternatives for learners without devices. Additionally, watch out for repeating certain phrases like "checking a source before using its facts," which can disrupt the flow of your argument. Your formal tone and awareness of the school community are commendable. Keep refining your sentence structures and elaborating on your evidence!
